# Authentication Result

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:AuthenticationResult`](gmeow-AuthenticationResult.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/AuthenticationResult>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)
